capture_method: Playwright-rendered spothero.com pages (facility dehydrated-state JSON, airport __NEXT_DATA__ airportSpots, destination/search/city/airport HTML) plus direct HTTPS fetches of the resolved cloudinary.com/spothero and spothero.com static media URLs the live pages serve
notes: Every entry is a real upstream media file fetched at its resolved URL.
Facility photos use the cloudinary transforms the live facility pages render.
Verified byte- and hash-exact by scripts/check_asset_inventory.py at build time.
